core_reasoning_9:
\section*{Claim}
For the two-dimensional $SU(N)$ lattice Yang-Mills plaquette partition function
\[
Z(\lambda)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty}\det\bigl(I_{i-j+n}(N/\lambda)\bigr)_{1\leq i,j\leq N},
\]
let $W_1:=\operatorname{tr}(U_P)$ denote the unnormalized plaquette Wilson loop used in the analytic one-plaquette formula. If the paper's plaquette identity is
\[
\langle W_1\rangle=-\left(\frac{\lambda}{N}\right)^2\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda),
\]
and $w_P:=N^{-1}W_1$ is the normalized Wilson loop used in the bootstrap equations, then
\[
\langle w_P\rangle=-\frac{\lambda^2}{N^3}\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda).
\]

\section*{Premises}
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\text{(P1)} & \displaystyle N\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 2},\qquad \lambda>0.\\[0.8em]
\text{(P2)} & \displaystyle Z(\lambda):=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty}\det\bigl(I_{i-j+n}(N/\lambda)\bigr)_{1\leq i,j\leq N}.\\[0.8em]
\text{(P3)} & \displaystyle \langle W_1\rangle=-\left(\frac{\lambda}{N}\right)^2\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda).\\[0.8em]
\text{(P4)} & \displaystyle w_P:=\frac{1}{N}W_1.\\[0.8em]
\text{(P5)} & \displaystyle \langle aX+bY\rangle=a\langle X\rangle+b\langle Y\rangle\quad\text{for constants }a,b\text{ independent of the gauge fields.}
\end{array}
\]

\section*{Derivation}
\begin{align}
\langle w_P\rangle
&=\left\langle \frac{1}{N}W_1\right\rangle && \text{by (P4)}\\
&=\frac{1}{N}\langle W_1\rangle && \text{by linearity (P5)}\\
&=\frac{1}{N}\left[-\left(\frac{\lambda}{N}\right)^2\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda)\right] && \text{by (P3)}\\
&=-\frac{1}{N}\frac{\lambda^2}{N^2}\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda) && \text{since }(\lambda/N)^2=\lambda^2/N^2\\
&=-\frac{\lambda^2}{N^3}\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda). && \text{collect powers of }N
\end{align}

\section*{Final Result}
\[
\boxed{\langle W_1\rangle=-\left(\frac{\lambda}{N}\right)^2\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda),\qquad \langle w_P\rangle=-\frac{\lambda^2}{N^3}\partial_\lambda\log Z(\lambda)}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$
